title: How to navigate the SIEM correlation rule set | Kaspersky official blog
description: This content is an analysis discussing the effective use of SIEM correlation rules in security monitoring. It emphasizes that the mere number of correlation rules or MITRE ATT&CK coverage percentages does not guarantee SIEM effectiveness. Instead, the utility of rules depends on whether the SIEM receives the relevant event data from connected sources. The article advises starting SIEM setup by identifying connected event sources before selecting applicable rules. It also highlights the importance of understanding which events each rule requires and regularly reviewing SIEM configurations as infrastructure evolves. The piece introduces a Kaspersky tool to help analysts match rules to their event sources and assess MITRE ATT&CK coverage in context.
